# Jackson House

> Jackson House is an elevated restaurant and craft cocktail bar in Woodinville, WA serving seasonal small plates, curated spirits, and memorable hospitality.

Last updated: 2026-10-12

Hours: Wed-Thu 5pm-10pm; Fri 4pm-10pm; Sat-Sun 3pm-10pm
Happy Hour: Wed-Thu 5pm-6pm; Fri 4pm-6pm; Sat-Sun 3pm-4pm
Address: 17409 133rd Ave NE #1203, Woodinville, WA 98072
Phone: (425) 364-4544
Email: info@jacksonhousewoodinville.com

Jackson House is a beautifully appointed dining room and whiskey-driven bar and lounge. We celebrate the best of the Pacific Northwest through intricately crafted cocktails, seasonally driven cuisine, and warm hospitality.
Our Dining Room offers a full-service restaurant experience with locally inspired, chef-driven artisanal plates designed to be shared (or not).
Our Bar & Lounge features a relaxed, small-bite-focused, self-service format, with approachable team members ensuring a smooth experience. Join us midweek for gathering nights, including Vinyl Night on Thursdays. Visit on Wednesdays for Mystery Flight Night (guess all three pours correctly for a bonus pour) and half-price bottled wine.
Reservations are available in the dining room, or stop by and enjoy our lounge experience without a reservation.

## Planning Your Visit
- Can I visit without a reservation? Yes. Walk-ins are welcome in our Bar & Lounge without a reservation. Reservations are available for the full-service Dining Room.
- How does lounge service work? Our Bar & Lounge offers a relaxed, self-service format with small plates and craft cocktails. Our team is on hand to help.
- Where can I park? Parking is in the District Flats Apartments parking garage, with free parking validation.
- What if I have dietary restrictions or food allergies? Please contact our team before your visit to discuss your dietary needs or food allergies and ask what options are available on the current seasonal menu.

- Dates: October 18-31, 2026
- Celebrate Seattle Restaurant Week at Jackson House with menus that showcase Pacific Northwest ingredients and signature dishes.

### Signature Picks ($65) - dishes that define Jackson House
- dungeness cheesecake - caramelized onions, dungeness crab, lemon oil
- bacon & egg caesar - 6-minute egg, local romaine, bacon, chili oil
- charred lamb rib chops - charred green onion vin., sweet potato puree

- Booking note: Restaurant Week is expected to be busiest Friday and Saturday. For more availability, please consider a weekday or Sunday. Walk-in seating may be limited during peak times.

### Wine
#### Wine by the Glass
- tirriddis 'house gris' - sparkling pinot gris ($15 glass; $50 bottle): n/v - columbia valley, wa; Tasting notes: pear tart, fresh sage, brioche, and enough acidity to keep things interesting
- pardevalles - albarin blanco ($15 glass; $48 bottle): 2024 - leon, sp; Tasting notes: who needs sauvignon blanc when you can have this? pair with hot honey carrots
- landauer-gisperg - gruner veltliner ($13 glass; $52 bottle): 2024 - tattendorf, austria; Tasting notes: the best thing out of austria since mozart. pair with crispy mushrooms
- domaine boutet saulnier - vouvray ($17 glass; $68 bottle): 2024 - chenin blanc - loire, fr; Tasting notes: golden apple, honey, and a little mineral mischief. chenin does what chenin wants
- maison brotte 'bord elegance' - laudun blanc ($14 glass; $56 bottle): 2025 - grenache blanc, marsanne, roussanne - rhone, fr; Tasting notes: tastes like the french countryside without paying for the airfare
- fossil & fawn - chardonnay ($16 glass; $64 bottle): 2024 - willamette valley, or; Tasting notes: chardonnay with a sense of humor. not your granny's chardonnay
- gilbert cellars 'tv wine' - rose ($16 glass; $64 bottle): 2025 - tempranillo, verdelho - yak valley, wa; Tasting notes: is it rose? is it red? who cares! it's delicious
- domaine dupre 'chai d'oevre' - morgon ($17 glass; $68 bottle): 2023 - gamay noir - beaujolais, fr; Tasting notes: crunchy cherry, violets, & pepper. basically pinot noir after two espressos. pair with seared duck
- domaine de couron - cotes du rhone ($15 glass; $50 bottle): 2024 - grenache, syrah - rhone, fr; Tasting notes: if comfort food came in wine form
- result of a crush 'unnamed' - syrah ($18 glass; $72 bottle): 2022 - walla walla, wa; Tasting notes: dark fruit, pepper, savory herbs, smoked meat, and a little rustic swagger. pair with charred lamb chops
- cadence winery 'coda' - red blend ($16 glass; $64 bottle): 2023 - merlot, petit verdot, cab franc, cab sauv - columbia valley, wa; Tasting notes: big enough to make an entrance, civilized enough to not offend
- ethos - cabernet sauvignon ($15 glass; $50 bottle): 2022 - columbia valley, wa; Tasting notes: dark berries, and a long velvety finish. like putting on a tuxedo and refusing to explain yourself. pair with steak frites
#### Wine by the Bottle - Bubbles
- domaine ste michelle - brut rose ($40 bottle): n/v - columbia valley, wa; Tasting notes: so pink it's basically the lead in legally blonde
- moet & chandon 'imperial' - rose ($150 bottle): n/v - champagne, fr; Tasting notes: red fruit, crisp, and ready to celebrate
- dom perignon brut ($595 bottle): 2015 - champagne, fr; Tasting notes: bubbles with a trust fund. pair with everything. literally everything
#### White
- dossier wine collective 'flagship' - viognier ($105 bottle): 2023 - columbia valley, wa; Tasting notes: apricot, jasmine, spice, & enough perfume to enter the room before you do
- domaine du brusquie 'biais' - blanc ($75 bottle): 2024 - sauvignon blanc - occitanie, fr; Tasting notes: bright, herbal, citrusy, & so french it will judge your pronunciation
#### Red
- big table farm winery - pinot noir ($105 bottle): 2023 - willamette valley, or; Tasting notes: elegant enough for dinner, weird enough to keep things interesting
- upsidedown 'birds+things+flowers' - syrah ($105 bottle): 2023 - yakima valley, wa; Tasting notes: a syrah with the soul of a pinot noir
- cottanera - etna rosso ($84 bottle): 2022 - nerello mascalese - sicily, it; Tasting notes: volcanic, savory, and dangerously elegant. pair with bone-in ribeye
- anonimas 'os dunares atlantico' - rojo ($95 bottle): 2022 - caino tinto - rias baixas, sp; Tasting notes: bright, crunchy, & savory. the cool friend who refuses to tell you where they got their jacket
- cayuse horsepower 'the tribe' - syrah ($325 bottle): 2022 - columbia valley, wa; Tasting notes: blackberry, smoked herbs, black pepper, savory earth
